comparison.objective: Close a carton's flaps so it is ready for taping; the candidate sets and locks a robot gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered folding of compliant carton flaps and maintaining interleaved closure, not threaded tool use.
comparison.success_condition: Flaps must be closed in the taping-ready configuration; the indexed body lacks complete numeric thresholds.
comparison.reason: Folding packaging is clearly unrelated to mechanical calibration.
